# Getting Started

## Loading In 

```{r}
library(flowWorkspace)
library(Luciernaga)
library(Coereba)
library(flowGate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
TheseScripts <- list.files("R", pattern=".R", full.names=TRUE)
walk(.x=TheseScripts, .f=source)
```

```{r}
Folder <- "PMA_Antibody"
Subset <- "CD8"

StorageLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder, Subset)

PaCMAPPath <- file.path(StorageLocation, "PaCMAP")
if(!dir.exists(PaCMAPPath)){dir.create(PaCMAPPath)}

GoodbyeFileName <- paste0("CoerebaConcatenate_", Subset)
PaCMAPName <- paste0(GoodbyeFileName, "_PaCMAP")

PacMAPGS <- paste0(PaCMAPName, ".gs")
SavePaCMAPHere <- file.path(PaCMAPPath, PacMAPGS)
```

```{r}
PACMAP_GS <- load_gs(SavePaCMAPHere)
```

```{r}
ggcyto(PACMAP_GS[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="BV480-A", y="PE-Vio770-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

ggcyto(PACMAP_GS[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="PaCMAP_1", y="PaCMAP_2")) + geom_hex(bins=180)

plot(PACMAP_GS)
```

```{r}
#gs <- PACMAP_GS

BigSandworm <- function(gs){
  Paths <- gs_get_pop_paths(gs)
  Paths <- gsub("/", "", Paths)
  These <- Paths[!stringr::str_detect(Paths, "root")]

  BigSandworm <- map(.x=These, .f=LittleSandworm, gs=gs) |> bind_rows()
  return(BigSandworm)
}

LittleSandworm <- function(x, gs){
  TheSandSet <- gs_pop_get_data(gs, x, inverse.transform = FALSE)
  TheRetrieved <- Coereba::Coereba_FCS_Reversal(TheSandSet[[1]])
  TheRetrieved <- TheRetrieved |> select(where(is.character))
  TheRetrieved <- TheRetrieved |>
    group_by(bid, ptype, infant_sex) |>
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  TheRetrieved <- TheRetrieved |> mutate(Island = x) |> relocate(Island, .before=1)
  return(TheRetrieved)
}

# data <- ChipShatter
DesertMouse <- function(data, column="Island", Identity="bid", myfactor="ptype",
  subset="ThisName", OutPath){

  data <- data |>
    group_by(across(all_of(Identity))) |>
    mutate(Total = sum(Count),
           Ratio = Count / Total) |>
    ungroup()

  TheIslands <- data |> pull(column) |> unique()
  # x <- TheIslands[1]


  Plots <- map(.x=TheIslands, .f=DesertMouseVi, data=data, column=column,
  myfactor=myfactor, subset=subset, OutPath=OutPath)
  return(Plots)
}

DesertMouseVi <- function(x, data, column, myfactor, subset, OutPath){

  shape_ptype <- c("HU" = 22, "HEU-lo" = 21, "HEU-hi" = 21)
  fill_ptype <- c("HU" = "white", "HEU-lo" = "darkgray", "HEU-hi" = "black")

  shape_sex <- c("Female" = 22, "Male" = 21)
  fill_sex <- c("Female" = "white", "Male" = "black")

  if (myfactor == "ptype"){
    theshape <- shape_ptype
    thefill <- fill_ptype
  } else {
    theshape <- shape_sex
    thefill <- fill_sex
  }

  Internal <- data |> filter(.data[[column]] %in% x)

  Internal$ptype <- factor(Internal$ptype, levels=c("HU", "HEU-lo", "HEU-hi"))
  Internal$infant_sex <- factor(Internal$infant_sex, levels=c("Female", "Male"))
  
  Plot <- suppressWarnings(
    Utility_Behemoth(data = Internal, var = "Ratio",
      myfactor = myfactor, normality = "dagostino", shape_palette = theshape,
      fill_palette = thefill, cex = 2, size = 3, corral.width = 1,
      statsHeight = 1, scalePercent = TRUE, correction = "BH", keepNS = FALSE)
  )

  Filename <- paste0(subset, "_", x)
  Plot <- Plot + labs(title = Filename)

  ThePlotName <- paste0(Filename, ".png")
  TheFile <- file.path(OutPath, ThePlotName)
  ggsave(filename = TheFile, Plot, dpi = 600, width = 4, height = 3)

  return(Plot)
}
```

```{r}
Delivery <- BigSandworm(gs=PACMAP_GS)

Condition <- gsub("_Antibody", "", Folder)
theSubset <- paste(Subset, Condition, sep="_")

theSubset2 <- paste0(theSubset, "_ptype")

DesertMouse(data=Delivery, column="Island", Identity="bid", myfactor="ptype",
  subset=theSubset2, OutPath=PaCMAPPath)

theSubset3 <- paste0(theSubset, "_sex")

DesertMouse(data=Delivery, column="Island", Identity="bid", myfactor="infant_sex",
  subset=theSubset3, OutPath=PaCMAPPath)
```
